always overestimates the cost to reach the goal

b.txt still gives access to the data but c.txt becomes a dangling link
Both b.txt and c.txt become invalid
Both b.txt and c.txt remain valid

questions.q: Which of the following statements about functional dependencies is correct (by Armstrong's axioms)?
options: If A → B then B → A
If A → B and A → C then A → BC
If A → BC then B → A
If AB → C then A → C

questions.q:

An instruction depends on the result of a previous one
A branch changes the program counter

Both Statement I and Statement II are false

questions.q:

questions.q: The Brundtland Commission report 'Our Common Future' (1987) defined sustainable development as development that
options: Stops all use of natural resources
Meets present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their needs
questions.exp: This definition of sustainable development comes from the World Commission on Environment and Development.

questions.q: How many Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) were adopted by the UN in 2015 for achievement by 2030?
questions.exp: The 2030 Agenda adopted 17 SDGs with 169 targets; the Millennium Development Goals were eight.

questions.q: Carbon monoxide is harmful to humans because it
options: Combines with haemoglobin to form carboxyhaemoglobin
questions.exp: CO has far greater affinity for haemoglobin than oxygen, reducing oxygen transport.

questions.q: The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act was passed in India in
questions.exp: The Water Act was passed in 1974; the Air Act followed in 1981.

questions.q: Noise level is measured in
questions.exp: The decibel (dB) is the unit of sound intensity level.

questions.q: If the cost price of 15 articles equals the selling price of 12 articles, what is the profit percent?
questions.exp: 15 C = 12 S gives S = 1.25 C, so profit = 25%.

questions.q: In an election between two candidates, the winner got 55% of the votes and won by 3000 votes. How many votes were cast in total?
questions.exp: Margin = 55% - 45% = 10% of total = 3000, so total = 30000.

In a certain code, TEACHER is written as UFBDIFS. How is STUDENT written in that code?
questions.exp: Every letter is moved one step forward: S→T, T→U, U→V, D→E, E→F, N→O, T→U, giving TUVEFOU.

questions.q: Find the missing term: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, 42, ?
questions.exp: Terms are n(n+1): 1×2, 2×3, ..., 6×7 = 42, so the next is 7×8 = 56.

questions.q: Pointing to a lady, Mohan said, 'She is the daughter of the only child of my grandfather's wife.' How is the lady related to Mohan?
questions.exp: The only child of Mohan's grandmother is Mohan's parent; that parent's daughter is Mohan's sister.

questions.q: Rohan walks 10 m west, turns left and walks 15 m, turns left and walks 10 m, then turns right and walks 5 m. How far and in which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.exp: West 10, then south 15 (left of west), then east 10 (left of south) brings him back to the starting east-west line; then right of east is south, 5 m. Total 15 + 5 = 20 m south.

questions.q: How many odd days are there in 300 years?
questions.exp: 100 years have 5 odd days, so 300 years have 15 odd days; 15 mod 7 = 1.
